name: gh-conductor
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for gh-conductor: a project manager for coding agents, backed by GitHub Issues.

plugins.name: gh-conductor
plugins.description: Breaks a large feature into GitHub Issues, wires them as a DAG with sub-issues and blocked-by dependencies, and keeps agents and humans pointed at the next ready step.

plugins.name: gh-conductor-channels
plugins.description: Experimental (research preview): channels that push gh-conductor issue events (sub-issue state changes, comments on the watched issue) into a running Claude Code session.
